description: Branch R-SORT-3 Descriptor dispatch, locales beyond those retained, on ACCDB files made with the locale as the one varied element: 0x0409 (control), Russian 0x0419, Greek 0x0408, Danish 0x0406 and German 0x0407, each CreateDatabase(path, locale, 128) in its own file. The same 30 values (Cyrillic letters including the e-diaeresis and capital ya, Greek letters including final sigma and accented alpha, German umlaut and sharp-s forms with their expansions, Danish aa and a-ring and o-stroke) are written to T (K Text(255)) and read: CollatingOrder, GROUP BY K (first ID, count) in key order, and ORDER BY K, ID. Asks which of these locales sort differently from General on this corpus (the earlier corpora had no Cyrillic or Greek).
retentionNote: Designed r-q-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
